text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — Sev3: routing backpressure on inference-west1. Error rate spiked to 12% at 09:12 UTC, p95 latency up. Paging eng-oncall and infra.
carla_ops: Oncall here. Seeing spikes, routing errors 500/502 from embedder pool. Working on immediate fallback.
alice_ng: I'm on it, pulling logs now. Suspect KV cache thrash after weight rollout.
bob_kim: I can patch a routing rule to send traffic to fallback model-variant for affected customers. Quick test would take ~10m.
eve_cs: FYI customer-platinum reported 10% failed requests in last 15m, raising concern for SLA. https://redwood.internal/dashboards/incidents/2490012345
dan_product: Any visible data loss or just errors? need to scope customer impact for comms.
frank_sre: No data loss indicated, just transient 5xx. Requeues hitting retry budget. Circuit-breakers tripping.
alice_ng: Confirming pattern: KV cache eviction thrash coincides with a recent rollout of quantized variant q8-fast. Likely regression.
infra-bot: Applied temporary route: inference-west1 -> inference-east1-fallback for customers in rollout whitelist (started at 09:22 UTC).
carla_ops: Mitigation in place and error rate down to 3% for affected traffic. Still monitoring.
bob_kim: Creating remediation ticket INF-2490 to rollback rollout and add safer gradual ramp. Owner: @bob_kim. ETA initial rollback 30m.
alice_ng: I'll capture logs and add guardrails in the runtime to prevent kv eviction storms. Putting owner @alice_ng on follow-up. Est size: medium (3d) to develop and test.
dan_product: Need a post-incident review. Proposed: 2-hour postmortem sync + written postmortem doc. Who can own scheduling?
carla_ops: I can own scheduling. Propose tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Invite: eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, support, product.
eve_cs: I'll add customer impact notes and sample request IDs to the doc. Ticket INF-2491 created for customer comms follow-up. Owner @eve_cs. Est size: small (4h).
frank_sre: Action items summary so far:
- INF-2490 rollback + safer rollout gating (owner: bob_kim, prio: Sev3 rem, est: 6h)
- INF-2492 runtime guardrail for KV eviction detection + auto-throttle (owner: alice_ng, prio: P1, est: 3d)
- INF-2491 customer comms and SLA check (owner: eve_cs, prio: P2, est: 4h)
- Infra routing fallback playbook update (owner: infra-bot / infra team, prio: P2, est: 1d)
Please confirm owners and sizes.
bob_kim: confirmed on INF-2490. Will open PR, tag for fast review.
alice_ng: confirmed INF-2492, will include unit tests + chaos job. Moving to backlog but mark as quarter-critical.
dan_product: For prioritization: recommend INF-2492 and INF-2490 be included in Q2 reliability epic. INF-2491 and playbook update go to Q2.1 backlog.
carla_ops: Scheduling note: postmortem doc link https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INF-2490, meeting invite sent to participants for 16:00 UTC tomorrow.
frank_sre: Add remediation metric: reduce p95 routing latency by 20% and eliminate >5% 5xx spikes during rollouts. Track in Console.
eve_cs: I'll draft a short customer note after postmortem and link to status page once we have root cause.
alice_ng: Quick check command I'm running for investigators:
```
curl -s "https://logs.redwood/query?service=embedder&since=15m" | jq '.[] | {ts, err, model_variant, node}'
```
carla_ops: Thanks. Closing live page to oncall; transitioning to post-incident mode. If anything regresses, re-open with pager.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Incident channel closed for live mitigation at 09:38 UTC. Postmortem scheduled.
bob_kim: I'll post the INF-2490 rollback summary in the ticket once merged. Target: roll-forward or permanent fix by end of week.
carla_ops: All set. Will triage action items in our remediation board and correlate to Q2 planning. :white_check_mark:
